title: No test asserts a synthesized `fieldGroups` detail page renders its section headings — 979 tests pass with the headings blanked
body:
Filed unassigned, no labels — triage grades and routes it. Measured while attempting objectui#6190 (which is now `pm:blocked` on objectstack#11661; **this card is deliberately independent of how that disposition rules**).

## The gap

`packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:623` synthesizes a section per `fieldGroups` entry and `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:380` uses that output as the **default record detail page for every object declaring `fieldGroups`** — i.e. every tenant that has not assigned a custom page.

**Nothing asserts end-to-end that those synthesized sections actually render their headings.**

## How it was measured

While evaluating objectui#6190's proposed one-line edit at `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:190`, that edit was applied and the whole package run:

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ --maxWorkers=2
  → Test Files  104 passed (104)
    Tests       979 passed (979)
```

**979 tests pass while every synthesized section heading is blank.** The break is tenant-visible on a default page path and produces zero test signal.

## Why the existing coverage does not close it

Two suites each cover one half and neither spans the seam:

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` asserts the synthesizer's **output shape** (`expect(sections[0].title).toBe('基本信息')`). It never renders.
- The `record-details` renderer suites render **hand-authored** section fixtures. They never consume synthesizer output.

So the contract between objectui's own producer and its own consumer — the one that actually ships on the default page — is asserted at both ends and nowhere in the middle. That is the shape of gap that lets a one-line change look safe.

## What the pin should assert

Render a record detail page for an object declaring `fieldGroups` **with no assigned page**, through the real `buildDefaultPageSchema` → `record:details` path, and assert the section **headings appear in the DOM with their expected text**.

⚠️ It must be written so it **cannot pass in both states of the world**: it has to go red when the heading is blank. A pin that asserts sections merely exist, or that asserts on the synthesizer's return value, reproduces the current blindness in new syntax.

⚠️ ⛔ **Do not write this pin against either spelling as the canonical one.** objectui#6190 may or may not converge `title` → `label`; the pin must assert the **rendered heading text**, which is invariant under that decision, and must not encode `s.title` or `s.label` as the source. That is what makes this card independent of objectstack#11661 and safe to execute now.

## Dedup

Searched open issues for the synth→renderer seam, `buildDefaultPageSchema` coverage, and detail-section heading pins — nothing on this. Related: objectui#6190 (blocked; where this was measured) · objectui#6178 (`headerColor`, same renderer, ungraded) · objectstack#11661 (the disposition objectui#6190 waits on).
